# agents-teamwork

Universal multi-IDE agent teamwork: one `team-orchestrator` skill plus
per-tool role configs (root owns architecture and integration;
subagents supply bounded evidence and execution only).

Start here:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jessexu1818/agents-teamwork/main/README.md
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jessexu1818/agents-teamwork/main/guides/quickstart.md
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jessexu1818/agents-teamwork/main/guides/model-matrix.md
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jessexu1818/agents-teamwork/main/templates/skills/team-orchestrator/SKILL.md

Install: skills-only copy is the default 30-second path; full install
via `./setup.sh --target <repo> --tools all --components all --yes`;
per-tool global setup is manual (see global-setup guide).
